summary: Reads a fixed-size payload (0x40 bytes) out of a packet buffer for a caller-supplied slot index. Loads a packet handle from this[0x1E0], rejects a null handle, an out-of-range index, or an entry whose present flag (bit 0) is clear, then copies the 64-byte payload from the matched 116-byte entry into the output buffer and returns 1 (success) or 0. Structural twin of the NetworkPacketDataWriter cluster (0054fa00). Callers: VehiclePhysicsVelocityAngularVelocityIntegrator (00459AE0), CollisionDetectionSystem (004EA970).

local_names.v4: entry pointer into the packet element array

operations.description: Compute packet element address = data pointer at handle+8 + 116 * a2, using the 116-byte per-entry stride
Load packet handle from this[0x1E0]; if null, return 0
If requested index a2 is >= the packet entry count stored at handle+4, return 0
If the entry's flag byte at element+0 has bit 0 clear, return 0 (entry not present/finalized)
qmemcpy copy 0x40 bytes from element offset +52 into the caller's output buffer a3
Return 1 on successful payload copy, 0 on null handle, out-of-range index, or cleared present flag
Invoked by VehiclePhysicsVelocityAngularVelocityIntegrator (00459AE0) and CollisionDetectionSystem (004EA970) to fetch a packet payload by index
